name: Koala
summary: Enormous ears and a round black nose.
text:
Big furry ears, cut in layers of wood, and a round black nose. It sits with its arms resting and its belly full of light.

Almost all of the wood is left showing — this is the piece where the pine is most itself.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
